content.scenario: A consumer, Priya, filed a complaint with the District Commission. If the Commission does not decide on the admissibility of the complaint within the specified period, what happens?
content.outcome: If the District Commission does not decide on the admissibility of the complaint within the period so specified, it shall be deemed to have been admitted.
